title: fix(ci): bandit clean — nosec B310 on public urlopen, pin HF revisions (B615)
body:
## Summary

Fixes the `lint` job's bandit step that went red on main: 4 medium findings (2× B310 `urlopen`, 2× B615 unpinned `snapshot_download`).

- `stooq.py` / `yahoo_eod.py`: the existing `# noqa: S310` suppresses ruff but not bandit — added `# nosec B310` alongside (urls are hardcoded public endpoints `STOQ_URL` / Yahoo chart API).
- `VARIANT_HUB` entries gain `tokenizer_rev`/`model_rev` commit SHAs; `fetch_kronos_variant` now passes `revision=` to `snapshot_download` — fixes B615 *and* makes weight downloads reproducible instead of tracking a mutable branch.

Verified locally: `bandit -q -r src --severity-level medium --confidence-level medium` exits 0; ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy all clean.
